recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.
